title: cynoglossum montbretii
intro: Cynoglossum montbretii, commonly known as the Himalayan forget-me-not, is a plant species in the borage family (Boraginaceae). It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Cynoglossum montbretii include wound healing, reducing fever, and alleviating respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
